accessibility.description: Stylized human figure inside an enclosing circle representing universal access or accessibility features.

activity-log.description: A list of three stacked dots representing a history log or activity feed.

align-baseline.description: Horizontal bars representing options for aligning text or elements to a baseline.

align-bottom.description: A set of parallel horizontal lines representing options for element alignment or layout positioning.

align-center-horizontally.description: Three parallel horizontal bars representing options for centering text or content layout.
